# HousePlus Ltd — Guide for LLMs / AI Crawlers

HousePlus Ltd (https://www.houseplus.ltd) is a HousePlus brand operating under HousePlus Group.
HousePlus Group is the parent company and brand owner; its primary brand site is https://www.houseplus-ch.com.
This English-first brand/affiliate site serves wholesale, OEM/ODM and private-label buyers worldwide.

## Relationship to HousePlus Group
- Parent organization: HousePlus Group — https://www.houseplus-ch.com
- Brand: HousePlus
- Manufacturing: HousePlus Ltd operates the group's Zhongshan (Guangdong, China) smart factory.

English (en), French (fr), Spanish (es), Arabic (ar).
